extracted.intended_audience: readers of 19th-century sentimental/domestic fiction (general public, young adults/families)
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter excerpt from a 19th-century sentimental/domestic novel about a young woman nicknamed the Sea-flower who leaves her island home for Boston, encountering society, friendship, and early romantic interest. The text is narrative fiction (character development, dialogue, social scenes) rather than any evaluative guideline or rubric.
